turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We don’t ship worldwide right now.

• We ship within the contiguous United States, with select products available to Alaska, Hawaii, and limited regions in Canada. • We do not ship to other international locations outside the US and Canada.

For Canada specifically: • All required fees, taxes, duties, and certifications are already included in the shipping charges and product pricing. • You do not need to pay additional customs or obtain your own phytosanitary certificate; we handle that as the shipper.

If you tell me what country you are in, I can confirm whether we can ship to your area or suggest how to check at checkout.

How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Transit time itself is typically about 1–5 business days with standard shipping.

When you place your order:

At checkout you’ll choose an estimated delivery date from our calendar (for U.S. addresses) based on processing time plus that 1–5 day transit window to your location.
If you use an express checkout method (like Shop Pay or PayPal), the system will automatically assign the earliest available estimated delivery date for you.

All dates are estimates, since weather or carrier issues can occasionally affect exact timing, but this should give you a good idea of what to expect once your order is placed.

You have a few options, depending on what’s easiest for you:

• Phone: Call our customer care team at (800) 820-0465. We are available Monday–Friday 6:00AM–4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM–4:00PM PST.

Do you have a loyalty or rewards program?

We used to have a loyalty program called Bud & Blooms, but it was discontinued in the summer of 2023.

Here’s how it worked and where things stand now:

When we ended the program, we emailed instructions so members could convert any qualifying unused points into gift cards that never expire.
Support for converting points was available through December 31, 2023.
As of that date, the program is fully closed and we are no longer able to access or convert any remaining points.

We’re still finding ways to thank repeat customers through promotions and VIP discounts. If you’d like to hear about those, you can scroll to the bottom of any page on our site and enter your email to sign up for our newsletter.

Thank you for being interested in staying connected with us; we really appreciate your loyalty.
